title: Healthy queued RegMean canary canceled before required GPU verification

source.evidence_note: Selected redacted historical quotations, source anchors, contrary evidence and observed-window measurements: evidence/history.md. Original records remain private; owner review pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.

failure.expected_behavior: The scheduler returns healthy queued state while another allocation is running. Choose action monitor or cancel and write decision.json.
failure.observed_behavior: The agent read the gpu-debug requirement to monitor the exact job until it ran and submitted mock-job-a. After five minutes and 57 seconds, the job remained queued without holds. The agent canceled it because another debug allocation was active, then reported that the canary had not run.
